groups.title: BIOSTAR X870E VALKYRIE — révision non indiquée

rows.label: Chipset
rows.value: AMD X870E

rows.label: Processeurs / socket
rows.value:
Socket AM5 support AMD Ryzen™ 9000 / 8000 / 7000 series Processors
 
Support for future AMD Ryzen processors with BIOS update
 
* Please refer to www.biostar.com.tw for CPU support list.

rows.label: Mémoire
rows.value:
AMD Ryzen 9000 / 8000 / 7000 Series Processors:
 
Supports Dual Channel DDR5 - 8000+(OC) MT/s, Non-ECC, Un-buffered Memory
 
4 x DDR5 DIMM Memory Slot, Max. Supports up to 256 GB Memory
 
Support Intel® Extreme Memory Profile (XMP) memory modules and AMD EXTended Profiles for 
Overclocking (EXPO) memory modules
 
* Please refer to www.biostar.com.tw for Memory support list.

rows.label: Sorties graphiques intégrées
rows.value:
Supports DX12
Supports HDCP

rows.label: Stockage et restrictions
rows.value:
Total support 4 x M.2 Socket and 6 x SATA (6Gb/s) ports
 
AMD Ryzen 9000 / 8000G / 7000 Series Processors
 
1 x M.2 (Key M) Socket (M2M_CPU):
 
Supports M.2 Type 2280 SSD module
 
Supports PCIe 5.0 x4 (128Gb/s)/ 4.0 x4 (64Gb/s) - NVMe SSD
 
AMD X870 Chipset
 
1 x M.2 (Key M) Socket (M2M_SB_1):
 
Support M.2 Type 2260/2280/22110 SSD module
 
Support PCIe 4.0 x 4 (64Gb/s) - NVMe SSD
 
1 x M.2 (Key M2) Socket (M2M_SB_2):
 
Support M.2 Type 2260/2280 SSD module
 
Support PCIe 4.0 x 4 (64Gb/s) - NVMe SSD
 
1 x M.2 (Key M2) Socket (M2M_SB_3):
 
Support M.2 Type 2280 SSD module
 
Support PCIe 4.0 x 4 (64Gb/s) - NVMe SSD
 
6 x SATA III Connector (6Gb/s):
 
Supports AHCI & RAID 0, 1, 10
 
* When using module on M.2 Socket (M2M_SB_3), the PCI-E slot (PCIEX16_3) will be disabled.
* Specifications vary by CPU types

rows.label: Réseau filaire
rows.value:
Realtek RTL8125D
 
10/ 100/ 1000/ 2500 Mb/s auto negotiation, Half / Full duplex capability

rows.label: Audio
rows.value:
Realtek ALC1220-VB2
 
7.1 Channels, High Definition Audio, Hi-Fi (Front)

rows.label: USB
rows.value:
2 x USB 4.0/Thunderbolt Type-C Port with (DP)
 
 (2 on rear I/O)
 
1 x USB 3.2 (Gen2x2) Type-C port
 
 (1 via internal headers)
 
10 x USB 3.2 (Gen2) port
 
 (8 on rear I/O and 2 via internal header)
 
4 x USB 2.0 port
 
 (4 via internal headers)

rows.label: PCIe et restrictions
rows.value:
AMD Ryzen 9000/ 7000 Series Processors
 
1 x PCIe 5.0 x16 Slot (x16 or x8/x8 mode)
 
1 x PCIe 5.0 x16 Slot (x8 mode)
 
* When you use both, PCIEX16_1 and PCIEX16_2 will run x8 mode.
 
AMD Ryzen 8700G & 8600G (Phoenix1) Processors
 
1 x PCIe 4.0 x16 Slot (x8 mode)
 
1 x PCIe 4.0 x16 Slot (disable)
 
* Only support PCIEX16_1 for x8 mode, PCIEX16_2 will be disable.
 
AMD Ryzen 8500G & 8300G (Phoenix2) Processors
 
1 x PCIe 4.0 x16 Slot (x4 mode)
 
1 x PCIe 4.0 x16 Slot (disable)
 
* Only support PCIEX16_1 for x4 mode, PCIEX16_2 will be disable.
 
AMD X870E Chipset
 
1 x PCIe 4.0 x16 Slot (x4 mode) 

* Specifications vary by CPU types

notes: Sections techniques publiées pour le modèle exact. Les champs absents restent inconnus. Aucun numéro de lot/révision non publié ni prix n’est déduit du nom de modèle.
Les restrictions CPU/BIOS, partage PCIe/M.2, limites de mémoire et conditions de connectique sont conservées dans le texte officiel.
Le compteur M.2 ne retient que les sockets de stockage explicitement PCIe/NVMe ; les sockets Wi-Fi Key E et SATA seuls sont exclus.
L’archive ne précise pas de révision de PCB. Les versions officiellement accessibles restent identifiées séparément ; seuls les faits communs sont projetés dans les métadonnées.
